summary: Montreal, Canada, computer graphics software developer, founder of Exocortex, third largest contributor to ThreeJS, start-up founder, married with a one-year-old child, strong interest in 3D design and rendering technologies, active in the start-up community, educated at Seneca College in Toronto, expertise in JavaScript, C#, and WebGL, advocates for work-life balance with family and business, engaged in discussions about technology trends and their implications.
